reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:125-131, `@mixin order($val)` passes `$val` directly to `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` (line 126) and `-moz-box-ordinal-group` (line 127) without adding 1. Because those legacy 2009 flexbox properties are 1-based (default 1, positive integers per spec/WebKit) while `order` is 0-based (default 0), values are off by one relative to unstyled siblings and `0` is invalid in legacy WebKit.
